meta.title.string: Embed Fixer | Discord bot for fixing social media embeds

meta.description.string: Embed Fixer reposts links from X, Pixiv, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit and more so their previews actually show up in Discord. Used in 3700+ servers, open source, and self-hostable.

hero.tagline.string: When a social link doesn’t preview properly, Embed Fixer reposts it with a working embed, under the sender’s name.

problem.heading.string: Discord’s own previews often miss the part you wanted to share.

problem.cards.0.text.string: Sometimes there’s no preview at all, sometimes half of one.

problem.cards.1.text.string: You get a title card, but not the image.

problem.cards.2.text.string: Videos show up as a thumbnail that won’t play.

problem.cards.3.text.string: Have to open a browser just to see what you posted.

features.heading.string: Fixes links on its own, or by hand when you need it.

features.list.0.text.string: Post a link as usual. Embed Fixer reposts it through a webhook with your name and avatar, plus a reaction you can use to delete it.

features.list.1.text.string: Install it as a user app to use /fix or the right-click menu in DMs and servers that don’t have the bot.

features.list.2.text.string: In channels you pick, images and videos from X, Pixiv, Bluesky and Kemono posts are sent as files. Spoilered links stay spoilered.

features.list.3.text.string: {count} settings cover which sites, channels and roles get fixes, and how the fixed message is sent. Members can opt out with /ignore-me.

platforms.heading.string: Big platforms and niche ones, most with several fix services to choose from.

customization.heading.string: If a default doesn’t suit your server, change it.

customization.body.string: Most of these settings were added because someone asked for them. Set them with /settings in Discord.

customization.noResults.string: No setting matches that. Try “role”, “channel” or “webhook”.

customization.settings.0.description.string: Change the language used by the bot.

customization.settings.1.description.string: Turn off fixes for specific websites.

customization.settings.2.description.string: Extract images and videos from supported links in selected channels.

customization.settings.3.description.string: Channels here never receive embed fixes.

customization.settings.4.description.string: Only selected channels receive embed fixes. Overrides the blacklist.

customization.settings.5.description.string: Choose whether replying through the webhook pings the original author.

customization.settings.6.description.string: Skip automatic spoiler tags for extracted media in selected NSFW channels.

customization.settings.7.description.string: Add a reaction the original author can use to delete the webhook message.

customization.settings.8.description.string: Show the post’s text in selected channels when media extraction is on.

customization.settings.9.description.string: Choose which emoji is used for delete-by-reaction.

customization.settings.10.description.string: Choose which fix service is used for each website.

customization.settings.11.description.string: Choose whether links sent by other bots are fixed too.

customization.settings.12.description.string: Send fixed embeds and extracted media to one channel instead of the source.

customization.settings.13.description.string: Only members with selected roles get fixes. Leave empty to disable.

customization.settings.14.description.string: Show or hide a button that links to the original post.

customization.settings.15.description.string: Delete the original thread message after the fixed embed is sent.

customization.settings.16.description.string: Delete and resend through a webhook, reply to the original, or resend as the bot.

customization.settings.17.description.string: Remove the delete reaction after a set number of seconds.

customization.settings.18.description.string: Add a 🔄 reaction the original author can use to switch to the next fix service.

hosting.heading.string: Rather keep your data in-house? Host it yourself.

hosting.body.string: Embed Fixer is open source. Run it with Docker on SQLite or PostgreSQL, and your server settings stay on your own machine.

closing.heading.string: Add it once, and shared links preview properly from then on.
